pl.explain: Joshua 4:22 — “Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.”

pl.q: Name the place: “So that he forsook the tabernacle of ____, the tent which he placed among men;”
pl.explain: Psalm 78:60 — “So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;”

pl.q: Name the place: “In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of ____,”
pl.explain: Matthew 3:1 — “In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,”

pl.q: Name the place: “Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into ____ again.”
pl.explain: John 11:7 — “Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of ____, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,”
pl.explain: Isaiah 9:9 — “And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,”

pl.q: Name the place: “The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of ____, one;”
pl.explain: Joshua 12:23 — “The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;”

pl.q: Name the place: “____ is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.”
pl.explain: Jeremiah 48:4 — “Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Open thy doors, O ____, that the fire may devour thy cedars.”
pl.explain: Zechariah 11:1 — “Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of ____, where David was?”
pl.explain: John 7:42 — “Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?”

pl.q: Name the place: “Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of ____, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.”
pl.explain: John 11:1 — “Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh ____ for an inheritance.”
pl.explain: Joshua 14:13 — “And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And Joshua cast lots for them in ____ before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.”
pl.explain: Joshua 18:10 — “And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Moreover I will cause to cease in ____, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.”
pl.explain: Jeremiah 48:35 — “Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Thou breakest the ships of ____ with an east wind.”
pl.explain: Psalm 48:7 — “Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.”

pl.q: Name the place: “____ is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;”
pl.explain: Psalm 108:8 — “Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;”

pl.q: Name the place: “Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up ____ into his mouth.”
pl.explain: Job 40:23 — “Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of ____:”
pl.explain: Isaiah 37:21 — “Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:”

pl.q: Name the place: “So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of ____ warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.”
pl.explain: Isaiah 37:8 — “So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.”

pl.q: Name the place: “He maketh them also to skip like a calf; ____ and Sirion like a young unicorn.”
pl.explain: Psalm 29:6 — “He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of ____: there is no more strength.”
pl.explain: Isaiah 23:10 — “Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.”

pl.q: Name the place: “These things were done in Bethabara beyond ____, where John was baptizing.”
pl.explain: John 1:28 — “These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.”

pl.q: Name the place: “What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou ____, that thou wast driven back?”
pl.explain: Psalm 114:5 — “What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?”

pl.q: Name the place: “So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in ____ and Achaia.”
pl.explain: 1 Thessalonians 1:7 — “So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.”

pl.q: Name the place: “They made a calf in ____, and worshipped the molten image.”
pl.explain: Psalm 106:19 — “They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And the south, and the plain of the valley of ____, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.”
pl.explain: Deuteronomy 34:3 — “And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into ____.”
pl.explain: Joshua 3:11 — “Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.”

pl.q: Name the place: “But, when he was in ____, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.”
pl.explain: 2 Timothy 1:17 — “But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.”

pl.q: Name the place: “To all that be in ____, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.”
pl.explain: Romans 1:7 — “To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.”

pl.q: Name the place: “When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to ____, seeking for Jesus.”
pl.explain: John 6:24 — “When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.”

pl.q: Name the place: “They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; ____ is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.”
pl.explain: Isaiah 10:29 — “They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.”

pl.q: Name the place: “So Joshua ascended from ____, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.”
pl.explain: Joshua 10:7 — “So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Then will I make this house like ____, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.”
pl.explain: Jeremiah 26:6 — “Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.”

pl.q: Name the place: “____ therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.”
pl.explain: Joshua 14:14 — “Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And I will kindle a fire in the wall of ____, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.”
pl.explain: Jeremiah 49:27 — “And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to ____.”
pl.explain: Joshua 10:43 — “And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.”

pl.q: Name the place: “The king of ____, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;”
pl.explain: Joshua 12:9 — “The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;”

pl.q: Name the place: “And went away again beyond ____ into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.”
pl.explain: John 10:40 — “And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto ____; and they fought against it:”
pl.explain: Joshua 10:36 — “And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:”

pl.q: Name the place: “O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of ____, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.”
pl.explain: Psalm 42:6 — “O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.”

pl.q: Name the place: “And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward ____. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.”
pl.explain: John 6:17 — “And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.”

pl.q: Name the place: “Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at ____, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:”
pl.explain: Ephesians 1:1 — “Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:”

pl.q: Name the place: “The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in ____, in the holy place.”
pl.explain: Psalm 68:17 — “The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.”

pl.q: Name the place: “The Lord said, I will bring again from ____, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:”
pl.explain: Psalm 68:22 — “The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:”
